generator_semantics.communications: all rows are exported; frequency values are not numerically filtered
generator_semantics.runway: drawn only when both endpoint coordinates are valid; runway closed is not a drawing filter

runway_export_loop.evidence: The loop calls runway_tile_features for every runway before any parent-airport or runway closed filter.

generator_semantics.visible_airport: valid longitude/latitude and type != closed; scheduled_service does not filter

audit.scope: CN only; HK, MO, and TW are separate ISO-country records and excluded

frequencies.navigation_like_interpretation: These rows are emitted by the generator as communications; classification is based only on source type text, never on frequency value.

mainland_airports.visible_group_coverage_note: Frequency coverage is airports with one or more linked source frequency rows; runway_rows is a row count, separately from airports_with_any_runway_row.

geometric_consistency_candidates.airport_distance_method: Nearest point on the endpoint segment in a local equirectangular plane; candidate when airport point distance >= 5 km.
geometric_consistency_candidates.length_method: Haversine distance between complete endpoints; candidate when absolute difference >= 1000 ft and relative difference >= 25% of positive source length_ft.

time_fields.interpretation: The source-level updated_at exists; these CSV headers contain no per-record time field when their lists are empty.

suspected_anomalies_for_official_check.note: These are frozen-source observations and generator outcomes only. They do not establish current operating status, civil-transport classification, active frequency assignment, or official runway condition.
